purpose: Restore missing mandatory HGI LOAD implementation under the existing static schedule

2.name: FP8E4M3
2.conversion: exact binary32; NaN code to 0x7fc00000; signed zero retained

6.name: UE8M0
6.conversion: Exact existing STATIC LOAD: code255 qNaN; code0 binary32 0x00400000; othercode binary32 exponent

addressing_inventory: arbitrary element strides via existing serial semantics
indexed row stream with runtime I-list
B2 QID ownership and stack-local bounds
component_operation: One scheduled micro-op selects up to eight naturally aligned source elements from one captured 256-bit HBM sector and writes them to distinct word lanes of one VM sector
issue_resource: One fixed-time operation per cycle; no on-chip ready, credit or arbitration
late_sector_behavior: Scheduled operation faults and emits no write; never waits or shifts subsequent dates
phy_boundary: Existing 256-bit HBM response sector; all variable off-die admission/buffering remains at PHY boundary
native_vm_output: 281 bits = valid + ap(0) + sector address(15) + data(256) + word mask(8)
pipeline: exact conversion plus registered VM packet

throughput.qualification: Datapath peak per scheduled coalesced micro-op only. Not a whole-LOAD rate. Eight strided elements may require eight distinct HBM sectors and at least eight issue slots.
throughput.reuse_rule: Useful payload consumption is not external traffic: each actual PHY transaction transfers a full32B sector; the production owned-window proposal fetches32KiB perNPC2half-window and must price overfetch separately.

estimate.note: Pre-build sizing estimate only; synthesis determines actual cell/area, parent lot and clock sites must pass before any physical run
estimate.parent_lot_fit: No added coupon lot reserved; actual integration reuses existing vmdel LOAD type delta and must establish lot fit before route

open_die_integration: Current plan has no LOAD core; die owner must reserve lots and local clocks
Host/static calendar target and address micro-op compiler must be composed
Variable PHY arrivals must be captured before a proven drain deadline
Runtime indexed address generator/I-list port must retain existing semantics
VM write-port ownership must be reserved by static calendar
Four-stack/QID source and scratch capacity must be proved; no reservation inferred
microop_compiler_cost_rule: Group by (source HBM sector, destination VM sector, format); charge each unique source sector transfer, each VM packet and every fixed drain/decode date. Never price gather traffic at contiguous peak.
format_authority: Union of actual existing native static LOAD converter plus common five older generic mover formats. Older generic mover rejects UE8M0; static LOAD already accepts it.
pipeline_price: 3 additional registered stages conditional on this coupon being used; no production adoption or token rate claim
registered_edge_contract: Upstream source launches at edge E-1; component captures at E0, extracts at E1, emits packet after E2; native receiver captures at E3. Source launch to packet launch is three periods.
native_phy_pc_scope: Current source only logical stack2 controllers ctl_NW_p00..31. PC<16 landsNW,NPC2;PC>=16 landsNE,NPC2. Stack3 provider/scratch remains unbound.
native_vm_slot: Current native q0faces RG5/WG2: destination DQ slotWG+4=6; compiler reserves wslot_v/wslot6 and no competing writes.
